author: devbig030
body: Release-doc hygiene audit: v2/docs/support.md currently says 'From the v2 checkout'; latest public tree must never mention the repository's v1/v2 iteration split or Hermit/Reverie context. Final grep should reject those terms in packaged files except semantic format/API version identifiers (e.g. schema ...-v1).

author: devbig030
body: Packaging audit must cross-check every packaged doc against Cargo.toml include. Current include ships docs/** but not scripts/, benchmarks/, or poc/, so docs/benchmarks.md would contain a non-runnable ./scripts/run-benchmarks.sh instruction in the crate tarball. Either omit repository-only docs from the package or make their assets genuinely self-contained and packaged; cargo package --list plus unpacked-package smoke must catch this.

author: devbig030
body: Public tutorial gap found during coordinator audit: no packaged example invokes the generated #[pod] method API, and README's runnable list omits typed_mapping, C-SNZI/comparison, and schema_migration. Add a clean source-consumer #[pod] example covering supported scalar signatures, stable method IDs vs linker symbols, generated descriptor/bindings, MethodResolver authentication/lifetime safety, and image fingerprint handshake; make examples/README and top README complete and ordered. Reconcile the claim 'ships no injector' with the public injection connector types without implying the private demos are packaged.
